$comment: This file maps each canonical architecture document to the implementation
milestone(s) that realise it. That mapping is a PLANNING decision and cannot be
derived from the repository: nothing in an architecture document knows which
It is kept here rather than inside the architecture documents deliberately.
Recording a milestone inside a frozen document would mean amending frozen
architecture every time the roadmap moved — which is precisely what a freeze
exists to prevent. Architecture states what shall be true; the programme states
The DISTINCTION that keeps this honest: this file is an INPUT, and the coverage
computed from it is the MEASUREMENT. Declaring an input is legitimate. Declaring
a measurement would be the hand-authored status value R-13.1 prohibits — and a
milestone claimed here is still checked against the programme plan, so a mapping
to a milestone that does not exist is a finding, not a passing entry.
